rates.description: Открит корт с изкуствена трева. Посочената онлайн цена е за 60 минути на един корт, без треньор. Проверете цената за избрания час в графика; плащане на място.
rates.descriptionEn: Outdoor artificial-grass court. The listed online rate is for 60 minutes on one court, without a coach. Check the price for your chosen time in the schedule; pay at the venue.

businesses.qualification: The merchant's current, dated online calendar repeatedly offers the public 60-minute booking at EUR 10 for that one artificial-grass outdoor tennis court. Pay-at-venue is all that is represented. No trainer, other sport, guarantee of future prices, independently published hours, live GoRez slots or owner's photographs were inferred. Existing clay-court and coached tennis assets are inappropriate and were not selected for this intake.
businesses.identityCheck: Brand, booking-profile address, facility name and independently corroborated municipality/club data were compared to the existing catalogue; no matching entity, duplicate facility or telephone. Compare the full merchant profile and phone, not the shared booking provider host alone.

held.name: TK Team Kunchev
held.reason: Current club and facility partner name the 74 SU grounds and publish the same phone. But the current court calendar displays all entries closed or not available, with no valid fee; numeric placeholders are not free admission. Its former booking URI now redirects to a generic page; the formerly indexed EUR 8.18 is not current and is not a group-training fee. Different public map points on the school grounds cannot be used interchangeably as the court entrance. Keep pending until the current group or court option is independently confirmed bookable at the proper point.

safeguards: Only scoped public factual review, no accounts, mutations, paid integration, real reservations, copied venue images, inferred prices, or production changes.
